items.title: Unit 8 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
Let's listen to music. Sorry, we can't. My dad's asleep.

Asleep? Yes. He's a doctor. He works at night.

He goes to bed at eleven o'clock in the morning. He gets up at seven o'clock.

Hello girls. What's the time? It's seven o'clock.

Can we listen to music now? Sorry, we can't. My brother has dinner at seven o'clock. Then he goes to bed.

Girls. You can listen to music. Put on these headphones. Thanks, Mum!

items.title: Unit 8 · What's the time?
items.scene: My name's Ruby. This is my day. And this is my mum's day. In the morning, I get up at seven o'clock. I get dressed. I have breakfast — cereal, bread and milk. Then I go to school at eight o'clock. I go to school by bus. I take my coat, my school bag and my lunch box. Our school bus is blue. My mum's a doctor. She starts work at six o'clock, so I don't see her in the morning. She goes home at two o'clock and she cooks dinner. I see my mum in the afternoon and the evening.
